description:
Trailblazing afro-fusion artist Tim Lyre returns with an incendiary UK Garage remix of lead single ‘MASTA’ featuring British rapper Jords, put together by fast-rising Bristol-based producer Joe Sonar. 

The remix is a sure-fire dancefloor anthem, amplifying the infectious energy of the dancehall and amapiano-infused original, while showcasing Joe Sonar (previously known as ‘KREED’) as one to watch in the UK Garage scene this year.

'MASTA’ is the title track from Tim Lyre's acclaimed EP, heralded as one of the standout Afro-fusion projects in 2023, which dropped in November and has garnered widespread acclaim from industry tastemakers such as BBC 1Xtra, Notion, Complex UK, Wonderland, GRM Daily, Mixtape Madness and Wetalksound. 

Tim commented on the remix: “Senpai na masta, but this one na banger. Shout out to Joe Sonar, special one for real”. 

JOE SONAR represents a brand new project from Bristol based artist and music producer Joe Baker. Formerly known as KREED, Joe’s sonics have taken the UK sound system music scene by storm in recent years, resulting in collaborations with artists such as Gardna, Eva Lazarus, Rider Shafique, Catching Cairo, Killa P and many more. Alongside performances across staple UK festivals such as Glastonbury and Boomtown, Joe’s work as KREED also received heavy rotation on BBC Radio 1 & 1xtra, Rinse FM, Reprezent and KISS Fresh.

Moving into 2024 with a fresh alias, the JOE SONAR soundscape explores the depths of UK Bass music, whilst taking influence from across a wide scope of styles such as Neo Soul, Afrobeats, Psychedelia and Experimental styles from across the globe. With solid foundations of heavy low end frequencies coloured by cinematic melodies and intricate e!ects, the sound waves of JOE SONAR are set to reach new and exciting places this year.
